The '''Hall of Champions''' was located on [[Jervo's World]], a large network of swoop-dueling arenas above [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]] owned by [[Lhosan Industries]]. It was the biggest [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]]-bike course of its time and a subject of extreme interest of swoop bike fans. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tarrance]], the [[D'qell Sisters]] and [[Goethar Kleej]] had rode there.
